notes.title: Update v0.12
notes.content:
In this update I've reworked the skill point cost of the random draw to prevent overuse, and altered the games difficulty to change how long a good run can last from about 30 waves to over 100. I had a coding issue come up that delayed the release of this update by several weeks.

Patch notes:
[olist]
[*] high score is no longer gained by collecting xp crystals, it is now gained when an enemy is killed.
[*] xp crystals from asteroids and meteoroids no longer count towards reserve xp and have a visual identifier.
[*] xp goals now increase linearly rather than exponentially.
[*] high score and xp gained is no longer equal to enemy hp. It is now based on current wave and enemy type.
[*] asteroids and meteoroids now have more hp.
[*] random draw cost increased from 1 to 3.
[*] random draw/special draw costs now increase each use and reset every wave.
[*] added a visual marker for a weapons min/max range when mouse hovers over its weapon icon/press Q.
[*] enemies now gain strength at a decreasing rate each wave.
[*] added 120 seconds to wave timer, and a wave skip button that allows you to skip waves after 30 seconds. skipping waves adds a xp buff for the next wave.
[*] attacks will no longer fire if there are no targets within range, and now require attack sources to be within a certain range of the player.
[*] when hovering mouse over weapon icons/press "Q" weapon range data will be displayed, showing the weapons current target, distance to target and min/max range via visual markers.
[*] Increased player size
[*] doubled map size
[*] added zoom feature [mouse wheel]
[/olist]

notes.title: Update v0.11
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
this update has been in the works for just over 2 weeks now. I was hoping to get the basic skill trees finished in time for this update, but it turned out to be a bit much to finish in just 2 weeks, there's so much I'm wanting to get done it can be hard to focus on just one thing. In the end, despite not finishing the skill trees I feel this update brings enough new content to noticeably change the feel of the game for the better.

Bug fixes:
[olist]
[*] previously sound muting was not saved, now it is.
[*] Fixed the issue where if the player was in motion while the game was paused the player would keep moving.
[*] Fixed an issue with pathing that would cause lag with as few as 50 bullets on screen. now with high end computers it's possible to have 3000+ bullets on screen. though homing still causes lag at 1300.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to become unplayable if player paused game while upgrade cards were on screen.
[*] fixed an issue where all new weapon stats chosen without exiting the game would compound together
[*] +Various other small fixes
[/olist]

Major features:
[olist]
[*] Re-worked the probability/rarity system
[*] None-elemental attacks now give %25 of damage delt as xp
[*] Added more complexity to the status effect system. Now dual elemental weapons have innate status effects, and some status effects will mix to proc extra effects (bleed + Acid = +poison), or cancel an effect (bleed + burn = -bleed)
[*] Added the chance to upgrade most none-weapon stats with [i]Random Draw Level Up[/i] (rarity chances, enemy health bonus, mini-boss chance ect)
[*] Added [i]Random Draw Special Up[/i], which gives a chance to level up all universal status effect stats (burn damage, burn tic rate, burn duration ect). It cost 1 of each color skill point
[*] Added a short sprint/dash (Spacebar)
[*] Added some of the infrastructure needed to implement skill trees for each weapon and the player.
[/olist]
